    13→:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#171110;--sf:#231a19;--ink:#f3e8dd;--mu:#b09a8b;--ln:#392a29;--side:#1a1338;--sideh:#2a2158;--acs:#3a2711;--okb:#173526;--wnb:#3a2711;--head:#231a19}

    99→.toast.s{transform:none;opacity:1}
   100→.fl{display:flex;flex-direction:column}.lbl{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mu);margin-bottom:3px}

   140→<body>
   141→<div class="app" id="app">
   142→  <aside aria-label="Main menu">
   143→    <div class="brand">
   144→      <img class="lg" src="" alt="Sri Ram Sweets logo">

   152→  <header>
   153→    <button class="ib" id="tg" aria-label="Toggle menu"><svg class="i" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 6h18M3 12h18M3 18h18"/></svg></button>
   154→    <div class="hb"><img class="lg" src="" alt="Sri Ram Sweets logo"><b>Sri Ram Sweets</b></div>
   155→    <div class="sr"><svg class="i" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="M21 21l-4.3-4.3"/></svg><input id="gs" type="search" placeholder="Search modules, press Enter" aria-label="Search modules"></div>
   156→    <div class="sp"></div>

   158→    <button class="ib" aria-label="Notifications"><svg class="i" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M18 8a6 6 0 10-12 0c0 7-3 9-3 9h18s-3-2-3-9M13.7 21a2 2 0 01-3.4 0"/></svg><span class="dot"></span></button>
   159→    <div class="user"><div class="av">RS</div><div>Ram Sharma<small>Administrator</small></div></div>
   160→  </header>

   163→</div>

   166→<script>
   167→const P={home:'<path d="M3 11l9-8 9 8M5 10v10h5v-6h4v6h5V10"/>',
   168→import:'<path d="M21 8l-9-5-9 5v8l9 5 9-5zM3 8l9 5 9-5M12 13v8"/>',
   169→product:'<path d="M20.6 13.4l-7.2 7.2a2 2 0 01-2.8 0L3 13V3h10l7.6 7.6a2 2 0 010 2.8zM7.5 7.5h.01"/>',
   170→prod:'<path d="M12 2l10 5-10 5L2 7zM2 12l10 5 10-5M2 17l10 5 10-5"/>',
   171→sale:'<path d="M3 17l6-6 4 4 8-8M15 7h6v6"/>',
   172→bal:'<path d="M4 20V10M10 20V4M16 20v-8M22 20H2"/>',
   173→ret:'<path d="M9 14L4 9l5-5M4 9h10a6 6 0 010 12h-3"/>',
   174→rep:'<path d="M14 3H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v14a2 2 0 002 2h12a2 2 0 002-2V9zM14 3v6h6M8 13h8M8 17h8"/>',
   175→bill:'<path d="M6 2h12v20l-3-2-3 2-3-2-3 2zM9 7h6M9 11h6"/>',
   176→plus:'<path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/>',
   177→del:'<path d="M3 6h18M8 6V4h8v2M6 6l1 14h10l1-14"/>',
   178→edit:'<path d="M12 20h9M16.5 3.5a2.1 2.1 0 013 3L7 19l-4 1 1-4z"/>',
   179→x:'<path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18"/>'};
   180→const ic=k=>`<svg class="i" viewBox="0 0 24 24">${P[k]}</svg>`;
   181→
   182→/* ---------- Module definitions ----------
   183→   Import  : flat list, one row = one material entry.
   184→   Others  : one record per DATE -> { id, date, items:[ [col1,col2,...], ... ] }
   185→   field   : [label, type, options]  type: txt | num | sel | time | pn (product name) */
   186→const MODS=[
   187→{id:'import',n:'Material Import',d:'Inward entries, vendors and item history'},
   188→{id:'product',n:'Product',d:'Sweets and snacks catalogue (many items under one date)',cols:[['Product'],['Category','sel',['Sweets','Namkeen','Bakery']],['Price (₹/kg)','num'],['Status','sel',['Active','Inactive']]]},
   189→{id:'prod',n:'Daily Production',d:'Batches prepared on a date',cols:[['Product','pn'],['Batch'],['Produced (kg)','num'],['Time','time']]},
   190→{id:'sale',n:'Daily Sale',d:'Counter and wholesale sales',cols:[['Product','pn'],['Sold (kg)','num'],['Rate (₹)','num'],['Total (₹)','num']]},
   191→{id:'bal',n:'Balanced Product',d:'Closing stock after sales',cols:[['Product','pn'],['Produced','num'],['Sold','num'],['Balance','num']]},
   192→{id:'ret',n:'Returning Product',d:'Goods returned by customers',cols:[['Product','pn'],['Qty (kg)','num'],['Reason']]},
   193→{id:'rep',n:'Report',d:'Sales and profit reports',cols:[['Report'],['Period'],['Total (₹)','num'],['Status','sel',['Ready','Pending']]]},
   194→{id:'bill',n:'Bill',d:'Customer invoices',cols:[['Bill No.'],['Customer'],['Amount (₹)','num'],['Status','sel',['Paid','Pending']]]}];
   195→const MATS=[['Sugar','kg'],['Refined Flour','kg'],['Desi Ghee','kg'],['Cashew (Kaju)','kg'],['Almond','kg'],['Pistachio','kg'],['Milk Khoya','kg'],['Besan','kg'],['Edible Oil','L'],['Cardamom','kg'],['Saffron','g'],['Raisins','kg']];
   196→
   197→function seed(){return{
   198→import:[['2026-10-28','Desi Ghee',80,610,48800,'Amul Depot',1200],['2026-10-27','Sugar',200,44,8800,'Gupta Traders',600],['2026-10-25','Refined Flour',150,32,4800,'Sharma Mill',400],['2026-10-22','Cashew (Kaju)',25,780,19500,'Bihar Dry Fruits',500],['2026-10-20','Sugar',300,43,12900,'Gupta Traders',800],['2026-10-18','Desi Ghee',100,598,59800,'Sudha Dairy',1500],['2026-10-15','Milk Khoya',60,340,20400,'Kisan Dairy',700],['2026-10-12','Refined Flour',200,31,6200,'Patna Flour Mill',500],['2026-10-10','Sugar',250,45,11250,'Mahavir Traders',700],['2026-10-05','Edible Oil',120,128,15360,'Ruchi Oils',650]],
   199→product:[{id:'p1',date:'2026-10-28',items:[['Kaju Katli','Sweets',900,'Active'],['Motichoor Laddoo','Sweets',420,'Active'],['Aloo Bhujia','Namkeen',260,'Active']]},{id:'p2',date:'2026-10-26',items:[['Jalebi','Sweets',280,'Active'],['Samosa','Namkeen',240,'Active']]}],
   200→prod:[{id:'q1',date:'2026-10-28',items:[['Motichoor Laddoo','B-101',45,'06:30'],['Kaju Katli','B-102',20,'09:00'],['Jalebi','B-103',25,'11:15']]}],
   201→sale:[{id:'s1',date:'2026-10-28',items:[['Kaju Katli',6,900,5400],['Motichoor Laddoo',18,420,7560],['Jalebi',12,280,3360]]}],
   202→bal:[{id:'b1',date:'2026-10-28',items:[['Motichoor Laddoo',45,18,27],['Kaju Katli',20,6,14],['Jalebi',25,12,13]]}],
   203→ret:[{id:'r1',date:'2026-10-27',items:[['Barfi',2,'Past date']]},{id:'r2',date:'2026-10-28',items:[['Samosa',1,'Not fresh']]}],
   204→rep:[{id:'t1',date:'2026-10-28',items:[['Daily Sale','Today',16320,'Ready'],['Weekly Sale','This week',98450,'Ready'],['Monthly Profit','Oct 2026',310000,'Pending']]}],
   205→bill:[{id:'k1',date:'2026-10-27',items:[['#1041','Ramesh Gupta',1250,'Paid'],['#1042','Sunita Devi',860,'Paid']]},{id:'k2',date:'2026-10-28',items:[['#1043','Hotel Maurya',7400,'Pending']]}]}}
   206→
   207→const $=s=>document.querySelector(s);const LOGO='data:image/png;base64,';document.querySelectorAll('img.lg').forEach(i=>i.src=LOGO);$('#fav').href=LOGO;
   208→const KEY='sriram_erp_v2';
   209→function load(){try{const j=localStorage.getItem(KEY);if(j)return JSON.parse(j)}catch(e){}return seed()}
   210→function save(){try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(DB))}catch(e){}}
   211→let DB=load();
   212→
   213→const DF='<label class="fl"><span class="lbl">From</span><input type="date" id="fa"></label><label class="fl"><span class="lbl">To</span><input type="date" id="fb"></label>';
   214→const app=$('#app'),nav=$('#nav'),main=$('#main');
   215→let cur='home',tab='e',hm='Sugar',drawImp=null,armed=null;
   216→const today=()=>{const d=new Date();return d.getFullYear()+'-'+('0'+(d.getMonth()+1)).slice(-2)+'-'+('0'+d.getDate()).slice(-2)};
   217→const fd=s=>{const p=String(s).split('-');return p.length==3?p[2]+'-'+p[1]+'-'+p[0]:s};
   218→const unit=n=>{const x=MATS.find(m=>m[0]===n);return x?x[1]:''};
   219→const inr=n=>'₹'+Number(n).toLocaleString('en-IN');
   220→const esc=s=>String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c]));
   221→const uid=()=>Date.now().toString(36)+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6);
   222→const toast=t=>{const e=$('#toast');e.textContent=t;e.classList.add('s');clearTimeout(toast.t);toast.t=setTimeout(()=>e.classList.remove('s'),2200)};
   223→const count=m=>m.id==='import'?DB.import.length:DB[m.id].reduce((a,r)=>a+r.items.length,0);

   225→function buildNav(){

   227→ MODS.forEach(m=>{h+=`<li><button data-id="${m.id}">${ic(m.id)}<span class="lb">${m.n}</span><span class="bd">${count(m)}</span></button></li>`});
   228→ nav.innerHTML=h;

   232→function home(){

   234→ v.forEach((x,i)=>{c+=`<div class="${i==6?'t':''}"><span>₹${x}k</span><i style="height:${Math.round(x/mx*100)}%"></i>${days[i]}</div>`});
   235→ let h=`<div class="ph"><div><div class="crumb">Overview</div><h2>Dashboard</h2><div class="sub">Welcome back, Ram. Here is how the shop is doing today.</div></div></div>
   236→<div class="stats"><div class="stat"><p>Today’s sales</p><strong>₹16,320</strong><span class="tr">▲ 8.4% vs yesterday</span></div>
   237→<div class="stat"><p>Production</p><strong>90 kg</strong><span class="tr">▲ 3 batches</span></div>
   238→<div class="stat"><p>Closing stock</p><strong>54 kg</strong><span class="tr dn">▼ 12% vs yesterday</span></div>
   239→<div class="stat"><p>Pending bills</p><strong>₹7,400</strong><span class="tr dn">1 invoice open</span></div></div>
   240→<div class="two"><div class="panel"><h3>Sales this week</h3><div class="chart">${c}</div></div>
   241→<div class="panel"><h3>Recent activity</h3><ul class="act"><li><div>Bill #1043 created<em>Hotel Maurya · 10 min ago</em></div></li><li><div>Batch B-103 completed<em>Jalebi, 25 kg · 1 hr ago</em></div></li><li><div>Material received<em>Desi Ghee, 80 kg · 3 hrs ago</em></div></li><li><div>Return recorded<em>Samosa, 1 kg · 5 hrs ago</em></div></li></ul></div></div>
   242→<h3>Modules</h3><div class="grid">`;
   243→ MODS.forEach(m=>{h+=`<button class="card" data-id="${m.id}"><div class="ci">${ic(m.id)}</div><div><b>${m.n}</b><span>${m.d}</span></div></button>`});

   248→/* ---------- shared page shell + list ---------- */
   249→function shell(m,tabs){
   250→ main.innerHTML=`<div class="ph"><div><div class="crumb">Dashboard / ${m.n}</div><h2>${m.n}</h2><div class="sub">${m.d}</div></div><button class="btn" id="add">${ic('plus')}New entry</button></div>`
   251→ +(tabs?'<div class="tabs" id="tabs"><button data-t="e">Import entries</button><button data-t="h">Material history</button></div>':'')+'<div id="bd"></div>';
   252→}
   253→const acts=id=>`<td class="ac"><button class="x" data-edit="${id}" aria-label="Edit entry" title="Edit">${ic('edit')}</button><button class="x" data-del="${id}" aria-label="Delete entry" title="Delete">${ic('del')}</button></td>`;
   254→const th=cols=>'<thead><tr>'+cols.map(c=>`<th>${c}</th>`).join('')+'<th class="ac"></th></tr></thead>';
   255→const NONE='<div class="empty">No entries found. Use “New entry” to add one.</div>';
   256→
   257→function list(m){
   258→ const F={a:'',b:''};let q='';const imp=m.id==='import';
   259→ $('#bd').innerHTML=`<div class="bar"><input id="q" type="search" placeholder="Search in ${m.n}" aria-label="Search entries">${DF}</div><div id="fm"></div><div class="panel tw" id="tb"></div>`;
   260→ const tb=$('#tb');
   261→ const draw=()=>{tb.innerHTML=imp?itbl(q,F):gtbl(m,q,F)};
   262→ const openForm=ref=>{(imp?iform:gform)(m,ref,()=>{$('#fm').innerHTML='';draw();buildNav();mark()})};
   263→ $('#q').oninput=e=>{q=e.target.value.toLowerCase();draw()};
   264→ ['fa','fb'].forEach(id=>{$('#'+id).onchange=e=>{F[id==='fa'?'a':'b']=e.target.value;draw()}});
   265→ tb.onclick=e=>{
   266→  const d=e.target.closest('[data-del]'),ed=e.target.closest('[data-edit]'),l=e.target.closest('[data-mat]');
   267→  if(d){
   268→   const id=d.dataset.del;
   269→   if(armed!==id){armed=id;d.classList.add('arm');toast('Click delete again to confirm');setTimeout(()=>{armed=null;d.classList.remove('arm')},3000);return}
   270→   armed=null;
   271→   if(imp)DB.import.splice(+id,1);else DB[m.id]=DB[m.id].filter(r=>r.id!==id);
   272→   save();draw();buildNav();mark();toast('Entry deleted');return}
   273→  if(ed){openForm(ed.dataset.edit);$('#fm').scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'});return}
   274→  if(l){hm=l.dataset.mat;tab='h';drawImp()}};
   275→ draw();return openForm;
   276→}

   278→/* ---------- Material Import ---------- */
   279→function itbl(q,F){
   280→ let h='',n=0;
   281→ DB.import.forEach((r,i)=>{
   282→  if(q&&r.join(' ').toLowerCase().indexOf(q)<0)return;if(F.a&&r[0]<F.a)return;if(F.b&&r[0]>F.b)return;n++;
   283→  h+=`<tr><td>${fd(r[0])}</td><td><button class="lk" data-mat="${esc(r[1])}">${esc(r[1])}</button></td><td>${r[2]} ${unit(r[1])}</td><td>${inr(r[3])}</td><td>${inr(r[4])}</td><td>${esc(r[5])}</td><td>${inr(r[6])}</td>${acts(i)}</tr>`});
   284→ return n?`<table>${th(['Date','Material','Qty','Rate (₹)','Amount (₹)','Vendor','Transport (₹)'])}<tbody>${h}</tbody></table>`:NONE;
   285→}
   286→function iform(m,ref,done){
   287→ const ed=ref!=null,r=ed?DB.import[+ref]:[today(),MATS[0][0],'','','','','0'];
   288→ const vendors=[...new Set(DB.import.map(x=>x[5]))].sort();
   289→ const f=$('#fm');
   290→ f.innerHTML=`<div class="panel fp"><h3>${ed?'Edit':'New'} import entry</h3><div class="fm">
   291→<label class="fl"><span class="lbl">Import date</span><input type="date" id="f0" value="${r[0]}"></label>
   292→<label class="fl"><span class="lbl">Material name</span><select id="f1">${MATS.map(x=>`<option${x[0]===r[1]?' selected':''}>${x[0]}</option>`).join('')}</select></label>
   293→<label class="fl"><span class="lbl">Qty (<span id="u">${unit(r[1])}</span>)</span><input type="number" min="0" step="any" id="f2" value="${r[2]}"></label>
   294→<label class="fl"><span class="lbl">Rate (₹)</span><input type="number" min="0" step="any" id="f3" value="${r[3]}"></label>
   295→<label class="fl"><span class="lbl">Amount (₹)</span><input id="f4" readonly placeholder="Auto" value="${r[4]}"></label>
   296→<label class="fl"><span class="lbl">Vendor name</span><input id="f5" list="vl" autocomplete="off" placeholder="Type or pick vendor" value="${esc(r[5])}"><datalist id="vl">${vendors.map(v=>`<option value="${esc(v)}">`).join('')}</datalist></label>
   297→<label class="fl"><span class="lbl">Transportation charge (₹)</span><input type="number" min="0" step="any" id="f6" value="${r[6]}"></label></div>
   298→<div class="fa"><span class="sp"></span><button class="btn" id="sv">${ed?'Update entry':'Save entry'}</button><button class="btn g" id="cn">Cancel</button></div></div>`;
   299→ const calc=()=>{$('#f4').value=Math.round($('#f2').value*$('#f3').value*100)/100||''};
   300→ $('#f2').oninput=$('#f3').oninput=calc;
   301→ $('#f1').onchange=function(){$('#u').textContent=unit(this.value)};
   302→ $('#cn').onclick=()=>{f.innerHTML=''};
   303→ $('#sv').onclick=()=>{
   304→  const g=i=>$('#f'+i).value.trim();
   305→  if(!g(0)||!g(2)||!g(3)||!g(5)){toast('Please fill date, qty, rate and vendor');return}
   306→  const row=[g(0),g(1),+g(2),+g(3),Math.round(+g(2)*+g(3)*100)/100,g(5),+g(6)||0];
   307→  if(ed)DB.import[+ref]=row;else DB.import.unshift(row);
   308→  DB.import.sort((a,b)=>a[0]<b[0]?1:a[0]>b[0]?-1:0);
   309→  save();toast(ed?'Entry updated':'Entry saved');done();
   310→ };
   311→ $('#f0').focus();
   312→}
   313→function impPage(m){
   314→ tab='e';shell(m,true);let openF;
   315→ drawImp=()=>{[...$('#tabs').children].forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('on',b.dataset.t===tab));if(tab==='e')openF=list(m);else hist(m)};
   316→ $('#tabs').onclick=e=>{const b=e.target.closest('button');if(b){tab=b.dataset.t;drawImp()}};
   317→ $('#add').onclick=()=>{if(tab!=='e'){tab='e';drawImp()}openF()};
   318→ drawImp();
   319→}
   320→function hist(m){
   321→ const rows=DB.import.filter(r=>r[1]===hm);let qty=0,amt=0,tr=0;const vs={};
   322→ rows.forEach(r=>{qty+=+r[2];amt+=+r[4];tr+=+r[6];vs[r[5]]=(vs[r[5]]||0)+ +r[2]});
   323→ const u=unit(hm);
   324→ let h=`<div class="bar"><label class="fl"><span class="lbl">Material</span><select id="hs">${MATS.map(x=>`<option${x[0]===hm?' selected':''}>${x[0]}</option>`).join('')}</select></label></div>
   325→<div class="stats"><div class="stat"><p>Total received</p><strong>${qty} ${u}</strong></div><div class="stat"><p>Total amount</p><strong>${inr(amt)}</strong></div><div class="stat"><p>Average rate</p><strong>${qty?inr(Math.round(amt/qty*100)/100):'–'}</strong></div><div class="stat"><p>Transport paid</p><strong>${inr(tr)}</strong></div></div>`
   326→ +(rows.length?`<div class="panel tw"><table><thead><tr><th>Date</th><th>Vendor</th><th>Qty</th><th>Rate</th><th>Amount</th><th>Transport</th><th>Total</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows.map(r=>`<tr><td>${fd(r[0])}</td><td>${esc(r[5])}</td><td>${r[2]} ${u}</td><td>${inr(r[3])}</td><td>${inr(r[4])}</td><td>${inr(r[6])}</td><td><b>${inr(+r[4]+ +r[6])}</b></td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></div><p class="sub" style="margin:12px 0 24px">Supplied by: ${Object.keys(vs).map(k=>esc(k)+' ('+vs[k]+' '+u+')').join(', ')}</p>`:'<div class="panel empty" style="margin-bottom:24px">No imports recorded for this material yet.</div>');
   327→ h+=`<h3>All materials</h3><div class="panel tw"><table><thead><tr><th>Material</th><th>Entries</th><th>Total qty</th><th>Last imported</th></tr></thead><tbody>${MATS.map(x=>{const rs=DB.import.filter(r=>r[1]===x[0]);let t=0;rs.forEach(r=>t+=+r[2]);return`<tr><td><button class="lk" data-m="${esc(x[0])}">${esc(x[0])}</button></td><td>${rs.length}</td><td>${t} ${x[1]}</td><td>${rs.length?fd(rs[0][0]):'–'}</td></tr>`}).join('')}</tbody></table></div>`;
   328→ $('#bd').innerHTML=h;
   329→ $('#hs').onchange=function(){hm=this.value;hist(m)};
   330→ $('#bd').onclick=e=>{const l=e.target.closest('[data-m]');if(l){hm=l.dataset.m;hist(m);main.scrollTop=0}};
   331→}
   332→
   333→/* ---------- Date-wise modules (many items under one date) ---------- */
   334→function cell(f,v){
   335→ if(f[1]==='num')return`<td>${Number(v).toLocaleString('en-IN')}</td>`;
   336→ const s=String(v);
   337→ if(/^(Paid|Active|Ready)$/.test(s))return`<td><span class="pill">${s}</span></td>`;
   338→ if(/^(Pending|Inactive)$/.test(s))return`<td><span class="pill w">${s}</span></td>`;
   339→ return`<td>${esc(s)}</td>`;
   340→}
   341→function gtbl(m,q,F){
   342→ let h='',n=0;
   343→ DB[m.id].slice().sort((a,b)=>a.date<b.date?1:a.date>b.date?-1:0).forEach(r=>{
   344→  if(F.a&&r.date<F.a)return;if(F.b&&r.date>F.b)return;
   345→  const its=r.items.filter(it=>!q||it.join(' ').toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>-1);
   346→  if(!its.length)return;n++;
   347→  h+='<tbody class="grp">'+its.map((it,i)=>'<tr>'+(i?'':`<td class="dt" rowspan="${its.length}">${fd(r.date)}<small>${r.items.length} item${r.items.length>1?'s':''}</small></td>`)+it.map((v,ci)=>cell(m.cols[ci],v)).join('')+(i?'':acts(r.id).replace('<td class="ac">',`<td class="ac" rowspan="${its.length}">`))+'</tr>').join('')+'</tbody>'});
   348→ return n?`<table>${th(['Date',...m.cols.map(c=>c[0])])}${h}</table>`:NONE;
   349→}
   350→function gform(m,ref,done){
   351→ const rec=ref?DB[m.id].find(x=>x.id===ref):null,f=$('#fm');
   352→ const blank=()=>m.cols.map(c=>c[1]==='sel'?c[2][0]:'');
   353→ let items=rec?rec.items.map(i=>i.slice()):[blank()],date=rec?rec.date:today();
   354→ const names=[...new Set(DB.product.flatMap(r=>r.items.map(i=>i[0])))];
   355→ const inp=(c,v,i)=>{const t=c[1]||'txt';
   356→  if(t==='sel')return`<select data-c="${i}">${c[2].map(o=>`<option${o===v?' selected':''}>${o}</option>`).join('')}</select>`;
   357→  return`<input data-c="${i}" type="${t==='num'?'number':t==='time'?'time':'text'}"${t==='num'?' min="0" step="any"':''}${t==='pn'?' list="pnl" autocomplete="off"':''} value="${esc(v==null?'':v)}" placeholder="${c[0]}">`};
   358→ const collect=()=>{date=$('#fd').value;items=[...f.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].map(tr=>[...tr.querySelectorAll('[data-c]')].map(e=>e.value.trim()))};
   359→ function render(){
   360→  f.innerHTML=`<div class="panel fp"><h3>${rec?'Edit':'New'} entry</h3>
   361→<div class="fm"><label class="fl"><span class="lbl">Date</span><input type="date" id="fd" value="${date}"></label></div>
   362→<div class="tw2"><table class="it"><thead><tr><th>#</th>${m.cols.map(c=>`<th>${c[0]}</th>`).join('')}<th></th></tr></thead><tbody>${items.map((it,i)=>`<tr><td>${i+1}</td>${m.cols.map((c,ci)=>`<td>${inp(c,it[ci],ci)}</td>`).join('')}<td><button class="x" data-rm="${i}" aria-label="Remove item" title="Remove item"${items.length<2?' disabled':''}>${ic('x')}</button></td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></div>
   363→<datalist id="pnl">${names.map(v=>`<option value="${esc(v)}">`).join('')}</datalist>
   364→<div class="fa"><button class="btn g" id="ai">${ic('plus')}Add item</button><span class="sp"></span><button class="btn" id="sv">${rec?'Update entry':'Save entry'}</button><button class="btn g" id="cn">Cancel</button></div></div>`;
   365→  $('#ai').onclick=()=>{collect();items.push(blank());render();const t=f.querySelectorAll('tbody tr');t[t.length-1].querySelector('[data-c]').focus()};
   366→  f.querySelectorAll('[data-rm]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{collect();items.splice(+b.dataset.rm,1);render()});
   367→  $('#cn').onclick=()=>{f.innerHTML=''};
   368→  $('#sv').onclick=()=>{
   369→   collect();
   370→   if(!date){toast('Please pick a date');return}
   371→   const rows=items.filter(r=>r.some((v,i)=>v&&m.cols[i][1]!=='sel'));
   372→   if(!rows.length){toast('Add at least one item');return}
   373→   if(rows.some(r=>r.some(v=>v===''))){toast('Please fill all fields in every item');return}
   374→   const out=rows.map(r=>r.map((v,i)=>m.cols[i][1]==='num'?+v:v)),list=DB[m.id];
   375→   const other=list.find(x=>x.date===date&&x!==rec);let msg=rec?'Entry updated':'Entry saved';
   376→   if(rec){rec.items=out;rec.date=date;if(other){other.items=other.items.concat(out);list.splice(list.indexOf(rec),1);msg='Merged into existing date'}}
   377→   else if(other){other.items=other.items.concat(out);msg='Added to existing date'}
   378→   else list.push({id:uid(),date:date,items:out});
   379→   save();toast(msg);done();
   380→  };
   381→ }
   382→ render();(f.querySelector('input[data-c]')||{focus(){}}).focus();
   383→}
   384→
   385→function gpage(m){shell(m,false);const openF=list(m);$('#add').onclick=()=>openF()}
   386→const mark=()=>nav.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('on',b.dataset.id===cur));
   387→function go(id){cur=id;mark();if(id==='home')home();else{const m=MODS.find(x=>x.id===id);m.id==='import'?impPage(m):gpage(m)}main.scrollTop=0;app.classList.remove('open')}
   388→$('#gs').onkeydown=function(e){if(e.key!=='Enter')return;const v=this.value.toLowerCase(),m=MODS.find(x=>x.n.toLowerCase().indexOf(v)>-1);if(m){go(m.id);this.value=''}else toast('No module found')};
   389→$('#tg').onclick=()=>{if(innerWidth<=860)app.classList.toggle('open');else app.classList.toggle('mini')};
   390→$('#ov').onclick=()=>app.classList.remove('open');
   391→let dk=matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
   392→$('#th').onclick=()=>{dk=!dk;document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme',dk?'dark':'light')};
   393→$('#today').textContent=new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-IN',{weekday:'long',day:'numeric',month:'long',year:'numeric'});
   394→buildNav();go('home');
   395→</script>
   396→</body>
   397→</html>
   398→
